words.en: A quarantine is a period of time during which an animal or person that might have a disease is kept away from other people or animals so that the disease cannot spread.

words.tr: n. 微光；隐约的一瞥; adj. 微弱地发光的；薄弱地发光的
words.ex: The glimmering of stars appeared in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中出现了星星的微光。
words.en: A glimmering is a faint, unsteady light or a slight sign or amount of something.

words.ex: He is puny and can't lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦弱，举不起那个箱子。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as puny, you mean that they are small and weak.

words.ex: He gave a paltry amount of money to charity.
words.ex_cn: 他捐给慈善机构的钱微不足道。
words.en: If you describe an amount of money as paltry, you mean that it is very small.

words.ex: The child played with a tiny worldlet in his toy box.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在他的玩具箱里玩一个小小的世界。
words.en: A small world or universe; a microcosm.

words.ex: The small village lies on the periphery of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于城市的外围。
words.en: The outer limits or edge of an area or object.

words.ex: The gas is in a gaseous state.
words.ex_cn: 这种气体处于气态。
words.en: Relating to or having the characteristics of a gas.

words.tr: v. 围绕； adj. 有环的；圈出（ring 的过去分词）；
words.ex: The moon was ringed by a halo of light.
words.ex_cn: 月亮被一圈光晕围绕。
words.en: Having or wearing a ring or rings.

words.tr: v. 重新做；重新加工；改动；重写
words.ex: He will rework the math problem after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后会重新做这道数学题。
words.en: To rework something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.ex: He is learning neurobiology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习神经生物学。
words.en: The branch of biology that deals with the anatomy, physiology, and pathology of the nervous system.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: The ball is spherical.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是球状的。
words.en: Something that is spherical is round like a ball.

words.ex: The comet has a bright cometary tail.
words.ex_cn: 这颗彗星有一条明亮的彗尾。
words.en: Of or relating to a comet.

words.ex: The nucleus of the team is the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的核心是队长。
words.en: The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group, forming the basis for its activity and growth.

words.ex: The gravitational force pulls the apple to the ground.
words.ex_cn: 引力把苹果拉向地面。
words.en: relating to or resulting from the force of gravity

words.tr:
n. 用力拉；拖拽；拖船
v. 用力拉；使劲拖；拖拽
words.ex: He gave a strong tug on the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用力拉了绳子一下。
words.en: If you tug something or tug at it, you give it a quick and usually strong pull.

words.ex: He helped me obligingly with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他乐于助人地帮我做作业。
words.en: If you say that someone does something obligingly, you mean that they are willing and eager to help.

words.ex: The car careened off the road and into the ditch.
words.ex_cn: 汽车失控冲出道路，掉进了沟里。
words.en: To tilt or cause to tilt to one side; to lean or cause to lean to one side, especially a ship for cleaning or repair.

words.ex: The inner room is quiet and dark.
words.ex_cn: 内部的房间安静而昏暗。
words.en: Located inside or further in; relating to the mind or spirit.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.ex: The sun vaporizes water from the lake.
words.ex_cn: 太阳把湖里的水蒸发了。
words.en: To convert or be converted into vapor.

words.ex: He bought a largish house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近买了一所相当大的房子。
words.en: Somewhat large in size.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: The law constrains companies from polluting rivers.
words.ex_cn: 法律约束公司不得污染河流。
words.en: To constrain someone or something means to limit their development or force them to behave in a particular way.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: adj. 漆黑的；墨黑的；极黑的
words.ex: The room was pitch-black at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚时，房间一片漆黑。
words.en: completely black or dark

words.ex: She wore a beautiful jewel on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一颗漂亮的珠宝。
words.en: A jewel is a precious stone that is used to decorate valuable objects such as rings or necklaces.

words.ex: The celebrity walked with her entourage.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人带着她的随行人员走路。
words.en: An entourage is a group of people who travel with and assist an important person.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.tr: adj. 气体的；含气的；气状的；<口>夸夸其谈的
words.ex: The gassy mixture exploded in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 这种气体混合物在实验室里爆炸了。
words.en: Containing or full of gas; characterized by an excessive amount of gas.

words.ex: The iceberg is floating in the cold sea.
words.ex_cn: 冰山在寒冷的海面上漂浮。
words.en: An iceberg is a large piece of ice that has broken off from a glacier and is floating in the sea.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: There is a small rift in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: A rift is a major fault or break in the Earth's crust.

words.tr: phrase. 裂谷；由地壳断裂下陷形成的狭长谷地
words.ex: The rift valley has many lakes and volcanoes.
words.ex_cn: 东非大裂谷有许多湖泊和火山。
words.en: A rift valley is a linear-shaped lowland between several highlands or mountain ranges created by the action of a geologic rift or fault.

words.ex: The sandstorm covered the whole city.
words.ex_cn: 沙尘暴覆盖了整个城市。
words.en: A sandstorm is a strong wind in a desert that carries clouds of sand with it, often making it difficult to see or breathe.

words.tr: n. 地狱；炼狱；无法控制的大火
words.ex: The city was an inferno of fire and destruction.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市成了火与毁灭的地狱。
words.en: An inferno is a place or situation that is extremely hot and fiery, resembling hell.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: The balloon is filled with helium.
words.ex_cn: 气球里充满了氦气。
words.en: Helium is a chemical element with the symbol He and atomic number 2. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas, the first in the noble gas group in the periodic table. Its boiling point is the lowest among all the elements.

words.ex: The sun produces energy through thermonuclear reactions.
words.ex_cn: 太阳通过热核反应产生能量。
words.en: Thermonuclear refers to the process or phenomena that involve the fusion of atomic nuclei at very high temperatures, as in the sun or in a hydrogen bomb.

words.tr: phrase. 达到法定年龄；到了成年
words.ex: He came of age last year and now he can vote.
words.ex_cn: 他去年成年了，现在可以投票了。
words.en: To reach the age at which one is legally recognized as an adult.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: The cows are grazing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛群正在草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.ex: I am busy for the moment.
words.ex_cn: 我目前很忙。
words.en: For the moment means for the present time, temporarily.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.ex: He garnered food for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他贮藏了过冬的食物。
words.en: To gather or collect something, especially information or support.

words.ex: The inquisitive child asked many questions about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 这个好奇的孩子问了很多关于星星的问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as inquisitive, you mean that they are interested in a lot of different things and want to find out more about them.

words.ex: He lives in a big metropolis with many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个有很多高楼的大都市里。
words.en: A metropolis is a very large city, often the most important city in a country or area.

words.tr:
adj. 埃及的；
n. 埃及语；
words.ex: She bought an Egyptian scarf at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一条埃及风格的围巾。
words.en: Of or relating to Egypt or its people, language, or culture.

words.ex: He felt envious when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到嫉妒。
words.en: If you are envious of someone, you want something that they have.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The geographer maps rivers and mountains.
words.ex_cn: 地理学家绘制河流和山脉。
words.en: A geographer is a scientist who studies the Earth's physical features and human populations, including their interactions with the environment.

words.ex: Ancient Egyptians wrote on papyrus.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人在纸莎草纸上写字。
words.en: Papyrus is a material similar to thick paper that was used in ancient times as a writing surface. It was made from the pith of the papyrus plant, Cyperus papyrus, a wetland sedge.

words.ex: The soldiers stayed at the remote outpost.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们驻守在偏远的前哨站。
words.en: An outpost is a small military camp or position at some distance from the main army, used especially as a guard against surprise attack.

words.ex: The old man has a cataract in his right eye.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人右眼有白内障。
words.en: A cataract is a medical condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque, resulting in blurred vision. It can also refer to a large waterfall.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The solstice happens in June and December.
words.ex_cn: 夏至和冬至分别发生在六月和十二月。
words.en: The solstice is the time of the year when the sun is at its greatest distance from the celestial equator, occurring around June 21 and December 21.

words.ex: We eat lunch at midday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from noon until early afternoon.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.tr:
adj. 沉思的；冥想的
n. 沉思；冥想
v. 沉思；默想；“muse”的现在分词
words.ex: He was musing about the meaning of life.
words.ex_cn: 他正在沉思生命的意义。
words.en: If you are musing about something, you are thinking about it in a deep and serious way.

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.tr: phrase. 镇定；沉着；遇事不慌
words.ex: He kept his presence of mind during the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中保持了冷静。
words.en: The ability to remain calm and think clearly in a difficult or dangerous situation.

words.ex: The curvature of the road makes driving slow.
words.ex_cn: 道路的弯曲使驾驶变慢。
words.en: The curvature of something is the fact that it is curved or the degree to which it is curved.

words.ex: The two lines intersect at point A.
words.ex_cn: 两条线在点A相交。
words.en: If two or more lines or roads intersect, they meet or cross each other.

words.ex: The circumference of the circle is 31.4 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的周长是31.4厘米。
words.en: The circumference of a circle is the distance around it.

words.tr: phrase. 步测；用步子量出（一段距离）
words.ex: He tends to pace out when he should be focusing on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他本该专心写作业时却常常心不在焉。
words.en: To walk slowly and steadily; to allocate time for activities.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.tr:
n. 地中海；
adj. 地中海的；
words.ex: He sailed across the Mediterranean last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天横渡了地中海。
words.en: relating to the Mediterranean Sea or the countries around it

words.ex: He comes from a seafaring family.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个航海世家。
words.en: Seafaring relates to travelling by sea, especially as a job or as a way of life.

words.tr: n. 海港；港口；港口城市
words.ex: The seaport was bustling with activity as ships were loading and unloading cargo.
words.ex_cn: 海港里船只正在装卸货物，一片繁忙的景象。
words.en: A seaport is a town or city with a harbor where ships load and unload.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.ex: He wants to circumnavigate the world by boat.
words.ex_cn: 他想乘船环游世界。
words.en: To circumnavigate means to travel all the way around the entire Earth or an island.

words.tr: n. 腓尼基人；腓尼基语 adj. 腓尼基的；腓尼基人的
words.ex: The Phoenician traders sailed across the Mediterranean.
words.ex_cn: 腓尼基商人航行在地中海各地。
words.en: Phoenician refers to anything related to Phoenicia, an ancient civilization located in the northern part of Canaan, along the eastern shores of the Mediterranean Sea. It is also used to describe the people of Phoenicia or their language.

words.ex: The pharaoh built a big pyramid.
words.ex_cn: 法老建造了一座巨大的金字塔。
words.en: A pharaoh was a king in ancient Egypt, considered a god as well as a political leader.

words.tr: adj. 史诗的；叙事诗的；宏丽的；
words.ex: The movie tells an epic story of heroes and dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影讲述了一个关于英雄和龙的史诗故事。
words.en: An epic is a long book, poem, or film, whose story extends over a long period of time or tells of great events.

words.ex: The voyager sailed across the ocean alone.
words.ex_cn: 这位航行者独自横渡了海洋。
words.en: A voyager is someone who goes on a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: The spacecraft landed safely on Mars.
words.ex_cn: 航天器在火星上安全着陆。
words.en: A spacecraft is a vehicle or machine designed to fly in outer space. Spacecraft are used for a variety of purposes, including communications, Earth observation, meteorology, navigation, space colonization, planetary exploration, and transportation of humans and cargo.

words.ex: He was known for his venturesome spirit and willingness to take risks.
words.ex_cn: 他以冒险精神和愿意承担风险而闻名。
words.en: If you describe someone as venturesome, you mean that they are willing to take risks, especially in order to try out new things.

words.tr: adj. 未充分发展的；初步的；基本的；
words.ex: His knowledge of math is rudimentary.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学的了解是初步的。
words.en: Rudimentary means relating to the basic or simplest aspects of a subject, or being in the earliest stages of development.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.tr: adj. 适于航海的；远洋航行的
words.ex: He works on a seagoing ship.
words.ex_cn: 他在一艘远洋船上工作。
words.en: Suitable for or engaged in sea voyages.

words.tr:
v. 细述；叙述
n. 叙述；重新计票
words.ex: He tried to recount the accident to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他试图向警察重新叙述那场事故。
words.en: To recount means to tell someone about something that happened, often in detail; or to count something again to make sure the number is correct.

words.ex: The navigator helped the ship find its way.
words.ex_cn: 领航员帮助船找到了航向。
words.en: A navigator is someone who is skilled in planning and directing the route of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments and maps.

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.ex: He reads his horoscope every morning because he believes in astrology.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看星座运势，因为他相信占星术。
words.en: Astrology is the study of the movements and relative positions of celestial bodies interpreted as having an influence on human affairs and the natural world.

words.ex: The new law gave impetus to environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 新法律为环境保护提供了推动力。
words.en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

words.tr: adj. 中间的；中游的；介于两者之间的; n. 中间人；媒介物；中间物
words.ex: He stood in-between the two cars.
words.ex_cn: 他站在两辆车之间。
words.en: An in-between thing or state is one that is between two other things or states, often in a way that is not clearly defined or that combines elements of both.

words.ex: The ember glowed in the cold night.
words.ex_cn: 余烬在寒冷的夜晚中发光。
words.en: a small piece of burning or glowing coal or wood in a dying fire

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He has all manner of books in his room.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间里有各种各样的书。
words.en: used to indicate a wide variety of something

words.ex: The peacock spreads its colorful tail.
words.ex_cn: 孔雀张开了它五彩斑斓的尾巴。
words.en: A peacock is a large bird, the male of which has very long tail feathers that it can spread out to display bright colors and patterns as part of courtship.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.tr: v. 猛冲；猛投；猛烈碰撞
words.ex: The car hurtled down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车飞速冲下山坡。
words.en: If someone or something hurtles somewhere, they move there very quickly, often in a uncontrolled way.

words.ex: The permanence of the statue reminds us of history.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像的永久性让我们想起历史。
words.en: The state or quality of lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.tr: phrase. 在黎明时分；在天刚亮的时候
words.ex: He walks his dog at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 他在黎明时分遛狗。
words.en: At dawn refers to the time of day when light first appears in the sky, before the sun rises.

words.tr: n. 商机；理想的工作或生活；
words.ex: He found a niche in selling eco-friendly phone cases.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售环保手机壳方面找到了商机。
words.en: A niche is a hollow area in a wall which has been made to hold a statue, or a comfortable or suitable position in life or employment.

words.tr:
n. 教堂的长凳式座位；座位
v. 排座位
words.ex: He sat on a wooden pew in the church.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在教堂里的木长椅上。
words.en: A long bench with a back, placed in rows in the main part of some churches to seat the congregation.

words.tr:
n. 拨浪鼓；嘎嘎声；咔嗒声
v. 发出格格声；使紧张不安；喋喋不休
words.ex: The baby laughed while shaking the rattle.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝摇着拨浪鼓笑了。
words.en: If something rattles or if you rattle it, it makes short sharp knocking sounds as it moves or shakes.

words.ex: He had an accidental fall while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他在走路时不小心摔了一跤。
words.en: An accidental event happens by chance, without being planned.

words.ex: The engineer checked the alignment of the wheels.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了车轮的对齐。
words.en: The arrangement of something in a straight line or in correct relative positions.

words.tr:
n. 平板；厚板；厚片
v. 切成厚板
words.ex: He broke the slab of concrete with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子砸碎了那块混凝土板。
words.en: A slab is a thick, flat piece of a hard material such as stone, concrete, or wood.

words.ex: He drew a dagger from his belt.
words.ex_cn: 他从腰带上抽出一把匕首。
words.en: A dagger is a weapon like a very short sword, used for stabbing.

words.ex: The line bisects the angle into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 这条线将角平分为两个相等的部分。
words.en: To divide something into two equal parts.

words.tr:
n. 退潮；衰退；减少
v. 退潮；衰退；减少
words.ex: The ebb of the tide left fish on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 退潮把鱼留在了沙滩上。
words.en: The movement of the tide out to sea.

words.tr: phrase. 涨落；兴衰；起伏（指事物像潮水一样有规律地变化）
words.ex: The ebb and flow of the tide changes every day.
words.ex_cn: 潮水的涨落每天都在变化。
words.en: The alternating movement or fluctuation between two states, levels, or conditions, often used metaphorically to describe the rise and fall of fortunes, feelings, or the natural cycle of things.

words.ex: The nomadic family moves with their sheep every season.
words.ex_cn: 这个游牧家庭每季都随着羊群迁移。
words.en: A nomadic way of life is one in which people move from place to place instead of living in one place all the time.

words.w: a matter of life and death
words.uk: ə ˈmætə əv laɪf ænd deθ
words.us: ə ˈmætər əv laɪf ænd deθ
words.ex: Choosing the right hospital for the surgery is a matter of life and death.
words.ex_cn: 选择正确的手术医院是生死攸关的事情。
words.en: A situation or issue that is extremely important and could mean the difference between life and death.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.tr: adj. 令人烦恼的；讨厌的；
words.ex: The noisy neighbors are troublesome.
words.ex_cn: 那些吵闹的邻居令人烦恼。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as troublesome, you mean that they cause you a lot of problems or worries.

words.ex: Some people believe in immortality after death.
words.ex_cn: 有些人相信死后会有永生。
words.en: The state of being able to live or last forever.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.ex: He worked hard and reaped the rewards.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，获得了回报。
words.en: To reap means to cut and gather a crop, or to obtain something, especially as a result of effort.

words.ex: The book delves into the mysticism of ancient religions.
words.ex_cn: 这本书深入探讨了古代宗教的神秘主义。
words.en: Mysticism is the belief that there is hidden meaning in life or that each human being can unite with God or the universe.

words.tr: n. 迷信；迷信观念（或思想）；
words.ex: He avoids walking under ladders because of superstition.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迷信而不愿从梯子下走过。
words.en: A superstition is a belief or practice resulting from ignorance, fear of the unknown, trust in magic or chance, or a false conception of causation.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medication to alleviate her menstrual cramps.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了药来缓解她的月经疼痛。
words.en: Relating to the menstruation or the monthly discharge of blood and mucosal tissue from the inner lining of the uterus through the vagina.

words.ex: The vagabond sleeps under the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这个流浪汉睡在桥下。
words.en: A vagabond is someone who wanders from place to place without a home or job.

words.tr: n. 喜爱；类同；密切关系；亲和力
words.ex: She has an affinity for painting.
words.ex_cn: 她喜爱绘画。
words.en: A natural liking for or attraction to someone or something.

words.ex: The roller coaster does a loop-the-loop at the top.
words.ex_cn: 过山车在顶部做了一个环形翻转。
words.en: A maneuver in which an aircraft or roller coaster makes a complete vertical circle.

words.ex: The astrologer told her fortune with stars.
words.ex_cn: 占星家用星星为她算命。
words.en: An astrologer is a person who studies the movements and positions of the stars and planets in the belief that they influence human affairs and natural phenomena.

words.ex: The star exploded into a supernova.
words.ex_cn: 那颗恒星爆炸成了超新星。
words.en: A supernova is the explosion of a star, which causes it to become extremely bright and then fade away over several weeks or months.

words.tr: n. 漫游者；流浪者；漂泊者；
words.ex: The rover explored the surface of Mars.
words.ex_cn: 漫游者探索了火星表面。
words.en: A rover is someone who travels around, often without a fixed route or destination. It can also refer to a vehicle designed to travel over the rough surface of a planet or moon.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: His rude words were an offense to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话冒犯了所有人。
words.en: An offense is a crime or a violation of the law; it can also refer to a feeling of being upset or annoyed by something perceived as insulting or disrespectful.

words.tr: phrase. 死罪；可判处死刑的罪行
words.ex: Murder is a capital offense in some countries.
words.ex_cn: 在一些国家，谋杀是死罪。
words.en: A capital offense is a crime that is punishable by death.

words.tr: n. 异兆；凶兆；不祥之兆
words.ex: The dark clouds were a portent of the coming storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云是即将到来的风暴的前兆。
words.en: A portent is an event or sign that is considered to indicate what is going to happen in the future, especially something very good or very bad.

words.ex: The people tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
words.ex_cn: 人民试图推翻腐败的政府。
words.en: To overthrow a government or a leader means to remove them from power, often by force.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.ex: The king's greed led to his downfall.
words.ex_cn: 国王的贪婪导致了他的没落。
words.en: The collapse of a person or organization's power, status, or success.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: He showed conformity with the group's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了小组的规定。
words.en: Conformity is the act of matching attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors to group norms or standards.

words.ex: He acted in conformity with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他按照规则行事。
words.en: If something is done in conformity with a rule, law, or custom, it is done in the way that the rule, law, or custom says it should be done.

words.ex: The picture is fuzzy and hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 这张图片很模糊，看不清楚。
words.en: Something that is fuzzy is unclear or indistinct, often because it is out of focus or because it is covered with a soft, fluffy material.

words.tr: adj. 虔诚的；信神的；伪善的
words.ex: He is a pious man who prays every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天祈祷的虔诚的人。
words.en: Someone who is pious is very religious and moral.

words.ex: The ruins show the antiquity of this civilization.
words.ex_cn: 这些废墟展示了这个文明的古老。
words.en: The ancient past, especially the period before the Middle Ages.

words.ex: He caught influenza last winter.
words.ex_cn: 他去年冬天得了流感。
words.en: Influenza is an infectious disease caused by the influenza virus, characterized by fever, sore throat, muscle pain, severe headache, coughing, and weakness.

words.tr:
n. 意第绪语或依地语
adj. 第绪语的；犹太人的
words.ex: He speaks Yiddish with his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他和祖母说意第绪语。
words.en: Yiddish is a language that was historically spoken by Ashkenazi Jews, based on High German with Hebrew and Slavic elements.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.ex: The relentless rain flooded the streets.
words.ex_cn: 无情的雨水淹没了街道。
words.en: Someone who is relentless is determined to do something and refuses to give up, even if what they are doing is unpleasant or cruel.

words.ex: He looked up the word in his lexicon.
words.ex_cn: 他在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person, language, or branch of knowledge.

words.ex: The teacher gave him an admonition for being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他迟到而给了他一个警告。
words.en: An admonition is a warning or a piece of advice that is given to someone to correct their behavior or to prevent them from doing something wrong.

words.ex: There is an inconsistency between his words and actions.
words.ex_cn: 他的言行不一致。
words.en: The quality or state of being inconsistent; lack of consistency.

words.ex: He reads his horoscope every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读自己的占星。
words.en: A horoscope is a forecast of a person's future, typically including a delineation of character and circumstances, based on the relative positions of the stars and planets at the time of that person's birth.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.tr: phrase. 开始从事；喜欢；形成...的习惯
words.ex: He took to swimming every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他开始每天早上游泳来保持健康。
words.en: To begin to like someone or something; to start doing something as a habit or regular activity.

words.ex: The answer is naught.
words.ex_cn: 答案是零。
words.en: Naught means nothing or zero. It is often used to indicate the absence of something or the result of an effort being unsuccessful.

words.tr: phrase. 归于无效；落空；白费
words.ex: His efforts came to naught because he gave up too soon.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力白费了，因为他放弃得太早了。
words.en: If something comes to naught, it fails completely or has no effect.

words.tr: phrase. 完全失败；终成泡影； 化为乌有
words.ex: Their plans for a trip came to nothing because of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他们的旅行计划因为下雨而落空了。
words.en: If something comes to nothing, it fails or does not achieve anything.

words.ex: I clicked the button to undo my mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我点击了按钮来撤销我的错误。
words.en: To undo something means to reverse the effect of a previous action or to untie or unfasten something.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.tr: adj. 伊斯兰教的；穆斯林的；
words.ex: The Islamic mosque is very old.
words.ex_cn: 这座伊斯兰教清真寺非常古老。
words.en: Relating to Islam or its culture, principles, and practices.

words.tr: adj. 不属于任何宗教派别的；心胸开阔的
words.ex: The school is non-sectarian and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是非教派的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Not involving or relating to different religious sects.

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.ex: He is a taoist who lives quietly in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位住在山里的道教徒。
words.en: A Taoist is a person who follows or practices Taoism, a philosophical and religious tradition that emphasizes living in harmony with the Tao (the Way).

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.ex: The planet has good habitability for life.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星球非常适合生命生存。
words.en: The quality of being suitable for living in.
